raw.excerpt: We are sharing a specialised part-time consulting opportunity for accomplished mathematics researchers experienced in research-level problem authoring, proof construction, proof verification, formalization, conjecture exploration, and advanced mathematical reasoning evaluation.
raw.description:
We are sharing a specialised part-time consulting opportunity for accomplished mathematics researchers experienced in research-level problem authoring, proof construction, proof verification, formalization, conjecture exploration, and advanced mathematical reasoning evaluation.

This role supports current and upcoming remote consulting opportunities focused on advanced mathematical reasoning, research-grade problem design, proof review, model output evaluation, formalization tasks, and high-quality project execution. Selected professionals will apply frontier-level mathematical judgment to author and review challenging problems, evaluate complex reasoning, and identify subtle mathematical errors that require working researcher-level expertise.

Key Responsibilities

Professionals in this role may contribute to:

Research-Level Mathematics Problem Authoring

  • Author challenging mathematics problems across pure mathematics, applied mathematics, theoretical computer science, statistics, or adjacent research areas
  • Develop tasks involving proof construction, proof verification, problem-solving, formalization, and conjecture exploration
  • Create materials that require research-level mathematical reasoning rather than textbook-level pattern recognition
  • Design problems with clear expected reasoning paths, rigorous standards, and high technical depth

Proof Review & Mathematical Output Evaluation

  • Evaluate mathematical outputs for correctness, rigor, clarity, and completeness
  • Identify subtle errors such as unjustified steps, misapplied hypotheses, hand-waved lemmas, invalid reductions, or plausible but incorrect proofs
  • Assess whether proposed arguments meet the standards of working research mathematics
  • Provide structured feedback explaining mathematical strengths, weaknesses, and required corrections

Research Calibration & Quality Review

  • Collaborate with a small program team and other senior contributors on task quality and difficulty calibration
  • Review evaluation materials for consistency, rigor, and research relevance
  • Help surface areas where current mathematical reasoning systems fail
  • Maintain high standards of accuracy, precision, and intellectual integrity across submitted work

Ideal Profile

Strong candidates may have:

  • Active or recent research role as a PhD candidate, postdoc, instructor, faculty member, principal researcher, industry research mathematician, or comparable contributor
  • Deep research expertise in pure mathematics, applied mathematics, mathematical physics, theoretical computer science, statistics, or a related field
  • Strong publication record, especially in leading mathematics journals, top specialty journals, or top-tier adjacent venues
  • Doctoral or postdoctoral training at a highly regarded mathematics, STEM, or theoretical research institution
  • Research honors, fellowships, grants, competition distinctions, or comparable signals of exceptional mathematical depth
  • Ability to evaluate complex proofs and identify subtle mathematical issues quickly
  • Excellent written communication skills and strong attention to detail

Educational Background

  • PhD, advanced doctoral training, postdoctoral experience, or equivalent research output in mathematics or a closely related field is strongly preferred
  • Outstanding senior PhD students and recent graduates with strong publication records may also be a strong fit
  • Research backgrounds in number theory, algebra, algebraic geometry, topology, analysis, PDEs, probability, combinatorics, dynamical systems, logic, representation theory, mathematical physics, theoretical computer science, or statistics are highly relevant

Nice to Have

  • First-author, sole-author, or otherwise substantial research publications in highly selective mathematics or adjacent research venues
  • Competitive fellowships, research awards, named grants, olympiad-level distinctions, Putnam-level distinctions, or comparable research signals
  • Experience reviewing proofs, supervising research, designing advanced mathematical problems, or evaluating formal reasoning
  • Familiarity with proof formalization, mathematical logic, proof assistants, or structured mathematical verification workflows
  • Availability for approximately 8–20 hours per week depending on project scope

Why This Opportunity

  • Apply research-level mathematical expertise to structured remote consulting work
  • Contribute to high-quality mathematical reasoning evaluation, proof review, and problem authoring
  • Work on flexible assignments aligned with your research area and mathematical depth
  • Use your ability to identify subtle reasoning flaws that only an experienced mathematician would catch
  • Remote structure with competitive hourly compensation

Contract Details

  • Independent contractor role
  • Fully remote with flexible scheduling
  • Eligible professionals should be based in the United States depending on project needs
  • Expected commitment of approximately 8–20 hours per week depending on project availability
  • Ongoing project structure with continuation depending on program needs and expertise alignment
  • Competitive rates between $100–$160 per hour depending on research seniority, credentials, and project scope
  • Weekly payments via Stripe or Wise
  • Projects may be extended, shortened, or adjusted depending on scope and performance
  • Work will not involve access to confidential or proprietary information from any employer, client, or institution

About the Platform

This opportunity is available through 24-MAG LLC. We connect experienced professionals with remote consulting opportunities across technical, evaluation, and project-based workstreams.

By submitting this application, you acknowledge that your information may be processed by 24-MAG LLC for recruitment and opportunity matching in accordance with our Privacy Policy: https://www.24-mag.com/privacy-policy.

raw.excerpt: was bieten wir?  Bei DACHS IT sollst du nicht einfach nur „eine Stelle“ haben, sondern ein Arbeitsumfeld, das zu deinem Leben, deinen Stärken und deinen Zielen passt.
raw.description:
was bieten wir?

Bei DACHS IT sollst du nicht einfach nur „eine Stelle“ haben, sondern ein Arbeitsumfeld, das zu deinem Leben, deinen Stärken und deinen Zielen passt. Deshalb bieten wir dir:

Remote-First als gelebtes Modell

Wir arbeiten seit Jahren konsequent remote. Du entscheidest, von wo du am produktivsten bist – Homeoffice, Shared Office oder eine Mischung aus beidem.

Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Eigenverantwortung

Du kannst dir deine Arbeit im Rahmen der Projekte zeitlich flexibel über die Woche einteilen. Uns sind Verlässlichkeit im Team und transparente Kommunikation wichtiger als Präsenz am Schreibtisch.

Spannende Projekte statt Routine-Tickets

Gemeinsam finden wir Projekte, die zu deinem Profil und deiner Entwicklung passen – z. B. Plattformaufbau, Cloud-Migration, Automatisierung, Operations oder technische Schulungen bei Kund:innen.

Weiterbildung, Zertifizierungen & Wissensaustausch

Regelmäßige Schulungen und Zertifizierungen sind fest eingeplant – mit Kostenübernahme und Freistellung. Dazu kommen interner Wissensaustausch, Sparrings auf Augenhöhe und Raum, dich fachlich wie methodisch weiterzuentwickeln.

Moderne Ausstattung & Arbeitsumgebung

Du erhältst moderne Hardware, die passende Software sowie das benötigte Equipment, damit du effizient und komfortabel arbeiten kannst.

Attraktive Rahmenbedingungen

Neben einem fairen Festgehalt bekommst du eine jährliche Beteiligung am Unternehmensgewinn. Je nach Rolle besteht zudem die Option auf einen Firmenwagen.

Transparente Feedbackkultur & Entwicklung

Wir setzen nicht auf jährliche Pflichttermine, sondern auf regelmäßige, ehrliche Gespräche auf Augenhöhe – du gibst uns Feedback, wir dir. So wissen wir alle, woran wir sind, und können unsere gemeinsamen nächsten Entwicklungsschritte gezielt unterstützen.

Gesundheit, Freizeit & Sicherheit

Du erhältst 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr, die nicht verfallen, sowie zusätzliche Absicherung, zum Beispiel durch eine Gruppen-Unfallversicherung. So bist du nicht nur beruflich, sondern auch privat gut aufgestellt.

Teamkultur & gemeinsame Erlebnisse

Trotz Remote-First ist uns persönlicher Austausch wichtig: Wir treffen uns regelmäßig zu gemeinsamen Aktivitäten – mal locker bei einem Get-together, mal zum gemeinsamen Workshop, mal aktiv bei Ausflügen – und sorgen so für echten Zusammenhalt abseits des Bildschirms.

wen suchen wir?

Wir suchen ein Teammitglied, das unsere Kunden im direkten Kontakt berät, gemeinsam mit ihnen bedarfsorientierte Lösungen entwickelt und sie bei der Umsetzung unterstützt. Du bringst idealerweise Begeisterung, Interesse und erste praktische Erfahrung mit Container- und Cloud-Technologien mit, bist motiviert, dich in neue Themen einzuarbeiten und verfügst über ein empirisch-agiles Mindset sowie ausgeprägte Problemlösungsfähigkeiten. Du arbeitest gern im Team, kannst dich aber auch selbst organisieren, Eigeninitiative zeigen und auf Deutsch wie auf Englisch sicher auf Business Level (C1/C2) kommunizieren. Freude am direkten Kundenkontakt – bei Bedarf auch in Rufbereitschaft oder vor Ort – rundet dein Profil ab.

was machst du bei uns?

Als DevOps Engineer betreust und berätst du unsere Kunden in technischen Fragen rundum die Themen Plattformaufbau, -operations und -integration:

  • Du kümmerst dich um den Aufbau und die Konfiguration von Containerplattformen.
  • Du verwaltest die Infrastruktur / Cloud / Containerplattform.
  • Du automatisierst mittels CI/CD-Pipelines.
  • Du übernimmst das Deployment von Anwendungen im Cluster und der Cloud.
  • Du bist für Monitoring und Performance Bewertung zuständig.
  • Du setzt dich regelmäßig selbstständig und in Schulungen mit den Themen rund um Container- und Cloudtechnologien auseinander und bildest dich weiter.

was bringst du mit?

Technical Skills

Must-have

  • Kubernetes
  • Linux
  • Kenntnisse mindestens eines der folgenden Cloud Stacks
    • AWS
    • GKE
    • MS Azure
    • OSP/Openstack

Nice-to-have

  • Grundkenntnisse in Terraform
  • Grundkenntnisse in Ansible
  • Grundkenntnisse der Go Language
  • Erfahrung aus dem IT Betrieb (Operations)

Soft Skills

Must-have

  • Deutsch und Englisch auf Business Level (C1/C2) in Wort und Schrift
  • Berater-Mindset/-Skills
  • Kommunikationsstark
  • Scrum-Kenntnisse

Nice-to-have

  • Projekterfahrung im agilen Umfeld / mit Scrum
  • Scrum Zertifizierung
  • Kanban-Kenntnisse
  • Moderations- und Deeskalationsmethoden
  • Lernmethodiken/Didaktik zur Schulungsdurchführung

wie sieht der bewerbungsprozess bei uns aus?

Wenn du dich bei uns bewirbst, begleiten wir dich transparent durch mehrere klar strukturierte Schritte. Uns ist wichtig, dass du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst – deshalb erhältst du in jeder Phase zeitnah Rückmeldung und alle nötigen Infos zum weiteren Ablauf. In der Regel durchläufst du dabei folgende Schritte:


Screening
Wir sichten deine Unterlagen sorgfältig und bewerten, ob deine Erfahrungen, Kompetenzen und Ziele zu der ausgeschriebenen Rolle und zu DACHS IT passen – auf dieser Basis entscheiden wir über eine Einladung zum Kennenlernen.

Kennenlerngespräch
In einem 30–45-minütigen Videocall lernst du ein Mitglied unseres Teams kennen. Ihr sprecht über deinen Hintergrund, unsere Kultur, Erwartungen beider Seiten und habt Raum für Fragen.

Technisches Interview
In einem 60-minütigen Termin löst du gemeinsam mit ein bis zwei unserer Consultants anspruchsvolle technische Aufgaben. Dabei geht es uns darum, deine Herangehensweise, dein Fachwissen und deine Zusammenarbeit im Team kennenzulernen.

Persönliches Gespräch
Anschließend triffst du unseren Geschäftsführer Alexander. Ihr besprecht verbleibende Fragen, Rahmenbedingungen und wie eine gemeinsame Zukunft bei DACHS IT konkret aussehen könnte.

Angebot
Stimmt die Vorstellung auf beiden Seiten, erhältst du ein Angebot von uns – transparent, nachvollziehbar und mit allen wichtigen Details.

raw.description:
Be part of a team that unleashes the power of leading-edge technologies to help improve the health and well-being of those most vulnerable in our country and communities. Working at Gainwell carries its rewards. You’ll have an incredible opportunity to grow your career in a company that values work flexibility, learning, and career development. You’ll add to your technical credentials and certifications while enjoying a generous, flexible vacation policy and educational assistance. We also have comprehensive leadership and technical development academies to help build your skills and capabilities.

Summary

As a Public Policy Analyst supporting the Patient-Centered Medical Home (PCMH) program at Gainwell, you will serve as a senior contributor and thought partner to the State. You will play a lead role in the design, development, and ongoing maintenance of pay‑for‑performance measures that support medical home models of care. The PCMH program is designed to improve quality of care, patient outcomes, patient experience, staff satisfaction, and healthcare efficiency, while minimizing overall costs.

Incentive payments driven by performance measures are calculated and issued to PCMH providers to encourage innovation and excellence and to support the added costs of care coordination and practice transformation. The measures are also used to assess and report medical home performance for use in managing the Medicaid program and to inform participating providers through a PCMH portal. In this role, you will apply deep data expertise and policy insight—particularly within Arkansas Medicaid—to influence incentive measure design and help the state manage a set of incentivized metrics to ensure the greatest impact on care delivery.

This position requires a strong understanding of how incentive measures influence provider behavior, healthcare outcomes, and the broader Arkansas healthcare delivery ecosystem, enabling effective collaboration with clients to continuously improve program performance.

Your role in our mission

  • Play a critical role in shaping PCMH program effectiveness measurements and incentive payment strategies to align with client program, policy, and organizational goals.
  • Serve as a strategic advisor to state stakeholders on PCMH program direction and tradeoffs.
  • Take a leading role in helping the state document, interpret, develop and enhance PCMH program policies and procedures.
  • Research national incentive methodologies, PCMH program operations, and the broader healthcare delivery ecosystem to recommend program improvements.
  • Assess the impact of incentive metric changes, policy updates, and funding options on Arkansas Fee‑for‑Service (FFS) providers.
  • Own the translation of business needs into clear data, system, and policy requirements.
  • Work with and guide the Data Analyst team to apply advanced analytical techniques to analyze large datasets and evaluate costs, trends, and reimbursement outcomes.
  • Synthesize analytic outputs to help in form program design and identify 2nd and 3rd level analyses
  • Help lead Gainwell’s team in the design, development, and implementation of incentive payment methodologies for PCMH providers.
  • Work with the Gainwell team to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and appropriateness of metrics produced by established analytical models.
  • Monitor State and Federal PCMH policy changes—with an emphasis on Arkansas Medicaid—and assess their operational and financial impact.
  • Partner with internal teams, business leaders, and external stakeholders to promote transparency and alignment in PCMH program performance measurement practices.
  • Prepare high‑quality written analyses, presentations, and recommendations for leadership, clients, and technical teams.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of experience in business analysis, financial modeling, health policy analysis, or a related field.
  • Master’s degree in Public Policy, Health Policy, Public Health, Public Administration, Health Data Analytics or a related discipline is preferred, but not required.
  • Strong data and analytical expertise with advanced proficiency in Excel.
  • Experience interpreting health care public policy at the state or federal level, preferably Medicaid and ideally in Arkansas.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable insights.
  • Strong ability to write and present comprehensive reports, analytical findings, and policy summaries for diverse audiences.

What you should expect in this role

  • United States remote opportunity
  • Video cameras must be used during all interviews, as well as during the initial week of orientation
  • The Deadline to submit applications for this posting is July 28, 2026

The pay range for this position is $81,100.00 - $115,900.00 per year, however, the base pay offered may vary depending on geographic region, internal equity, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. Put your passion to work at Gainwell. You’ll have the opportunity to grow your career in a company that values work flexibility, learning, and career development. All salaried, full-time candidates are eligible for our generous, flexible vacation policy, a 401(k) employer match, comprehensive health benefits, and educational assistance. We also have a variety of leadership and technical development academies to help build your skills and capabilities.

We believe nothing is impossible when you bring together people who care deeply about making healthcare work better for everyone. Build your career with Gainwell, an industry leader. You’ll be joining a company where collaboration, innovation, and inclusion fuel our growth. Learn more about Gainwell at our company website and visit our Careers site for all available job role openings.

What We Can Achieve Together:

The Communications Manager, Internal Communications, develops, manages, and implements business-focused internal communications plans that facilitate organizational clarity, alignment, and execution. The Communications Manager serves as a trusted communications partner to leaders and teams, providing guidance on message framing, sequencing, and delivery for complex, enterprise-wide initiatives. This position supports organizational decision-making, change, and operational effectiveness.

We're Looking for You:

The Communications Manager leads and manages internal communications priorities by setting direction for timing, channels, message development, and content planning. This position partners closely with senior leaders and cross-functional teams to design and deliver communications plans that align with strategies that build trust, reinforce alignment, and support a connected and informed employee experience across the organization.

RESPONSIBILITIES & SCOPE

  • Work closely with the Director of Internal Communications to develop, manage, and implement internal communications plans aligned with enterprise priorities.

  • Serve as a communications advisor to leaders, providing guidance on messaging, framing, sequencing, and organizational impact.

  • Lead communications for complex, high-risk, or enterprise-wide initiatives, including change, transformation, and operating model shifts.

  • Draft, edit, and oversee internal business communications such as executive messages, organizational updates, briefs, and talking points.

  • Support functional and executive communications by translating strategy and decisions into clear, actionable internal messaging.

  • Assist in planning and executing all staff events and leadership communications engagements, including run-of-show materials and briefing documents.

  • Align individual communications initiatives to shared priorities and enterprise-wide framing.

  • Manage assigned budgets, evaluate results, and develop recommendations for corrective strategies as needed.

  • Resolve complex issues independently and exercise sound judgment within program goals.

  • May supervise professional or administrative staff or mentor other individual contributors.

  • Occasional travel is required for business meetings and events, trainings, and/or team retreats and meetings.

  • Other related duties as assigned.

What You'll Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field and a minimum of seven years of experience in internal or corporate communications, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Experience advising senior leaders and supporting executive-level internal communications.

  • Experience leading communications for enterprise-scale initiatives, organizational change, or transformation efforts.

  • Advanced business writing experience where clarity, precision, and risk awareness are critical.

  • Experience developing communication and engagement strategies, evaluating effectiveness, and managing multiple complex communications projects simultaneously.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting communications in a large, decentralized, or matrixed organization. Experience managing a communications budget.

  • Familiarity with internal communication technologies and best practices.

  • Excellent writing, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.

  • Multilingual or cross-cultural experience and knowledge of current and evolving trends in internal and corporate communications.

This description is not designed to be a complete list of all duties and responsibilities required for this job.

The starting pay range for a candidate selected for this position is generally within the range of $69,275 – $103, 785. This range only applies to candidates whose country of employment is the USA. Where a successful candidate’s actual pay will fall within this range will be based on a variety of factors, including, for example, the candidate's location, qualifications, specific skills, and experience. Please note countries outside the USA would have a different pay range in the local currency based on the local labor market, and not tied to USA pay or ranges. Your geographic location will be confirmed during the recruitment.

Who We Are:

The Nature Conservancy’s mission is to protect the lands and waters upon which all life depends. As a science-based organization, we create innovative, on-the-ground solutions to our world’s toughest challenges so that we can create a world in which people and nature thrive. We’re rooted in our mission and guided by our values, which include respect for all people, communities, and cultures. Whether it’s career development, flexible schedules, or a rewarding mission, there’s many reasons to love life inside TNC. Want a better insight to TNC? Check out our TNC Talent playlist on YouTube to hear stories from staff or visit Glassdoor.

One goal is to cultivate an inclusive work environment so that all our colleagues around the globe feel a sense of belonging and that their unique contributions to our mission are valued. In addition to the requirements in our job postings, we recognize that people come with talent and experiences outside of a job and consider each applicant’s unique experience. Please apply – we’d love to hear from you. To quote a popular saying at TNC, “you’ll join for the mission, and stay for the people.”

What We Bring:

Since 1951, TNC has been doing work you can believe in. Through grassroots action, we have grown from a small non-profit into one of the most effective and wide-reaching environmental organizations in the world. Thanks to more than 1 million members, over 400 scientists, and the dedicated efforts of our diverse staff and partners, we impact conservation around the world!

TNC offers a competitive, comprehensive benefits package including health care benefits, flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) plan with an 8% employer match, parental leave, accrued paid time off, life insurance, disability coverage, employee assistance program, other life and work well-being benefits. Learn more about our Benefits and Perks here.

We’re proud to offer a flexible work environment that supports of the health and well-being of the people we employ.

Our recruiting process includes a rolling interview process to ensure we engage applicants in a timely manner. This means we may review applications in the order in which they are received. Once a strong candidate pool is identified, the role will be unposted. The timeline may vary depending on the expressed interest in the role, so we highly encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.

Employees must submit their application by logging into Workday and applying via the Jobs Hub.

The Nature Conservancy is an Equal Opportunity Employer.Our commitment to equal employment opportunity includes the recognition that our conservation mission is best advanced by the leadership and contributions of people of all backgrounds, beliefs, and culture. Recruiting and mentoring staff to create an inclusive organization is a priority, and we encourage applicants from all cultures, races, colors, religions, sexes, national or regional origins, ages, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity, military, protected veteran status or other status protected by law.

The successful applicant must meet the requirements of The Nature Conservancy's background screening process.

Do you have military experience? Visit our U.S. Military Skills Translator to match your military experience with our current job openings!

TNC is committed to offering accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please send a note to applyhelp@tnc.org with Request for Accommodation in the subject line.

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

The Senior Systems Analyst will support the Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts on the Centralized Accounting and Payroll/Personnel System (CAPPS) Program. This role is part of CPA's Fiscal Management Statewide Fiscal Systems team and provides advanced functional and consultative support across the CAPPS HR/Payroll tower, including HR/Payroll, Financials, STARR, and ancillary systems. The Senior Systems Analyst serves as a primary point of contact for CAPPS agencies, supporting functional design, system configuration, and compliance activities such as FMLA administration and WCAG 2.1 accessibility standards. The role also oversees batch job monitoring, Fiscal Year-End coordination, and the CAPPS Annual Disaster Recovery exercise. The Senior Systems Analyst works under minimal supervision, applying independent judgment to support a statewide network of more than 100 Texas state agencies and approximately 80,000 employees on the CAPPS Central platform.
Responsibilities:
  • Provide advanced consultative and functional support for the CAPPS HR/Payroll tower, including Workforce Administration, Payroll Interface, Commitment Accounting, Time and Labor, TAM/CG, and HR security setup, including row-level security.
  • Ensure CAPPS compliance with the Family Medical Leave Act (FMLA) by defining leave plans, customizing leave types, and supporting compliance reporting and auditing.
  • Serve as the functional point of contact for CAPPS agencies, creating and reviewing Functional Design Documents (FDDs) and performing functional configuration changes.
  • Configure system tables, business units, Set IDs, and table structures, and build workflow configurations using the Approval Workflow Engine (AWE).
  • Create queries and reports using PS/Query, SAP Business Objects, SQR, and BI Publisher, applying technical knowledge of Application Designer, Integration Broker, and SQL.
  • Monitor batch job schedules and execution, detect and respond to failures, validate output, manage dependencies, and document performance tuning activities.
  • Coordinate Fiscal Year-End activities, including reconciliations, system configurations, mass salary loads, and Benefit Enrollment Web Services integration with ERS.
  • Coordinate the CAPPS Annual Disaster Recovery exercise with the Managed Services vendor, including test scope definition, backup validation, and documentation of results.
  • Provide Level 2 Service Desk support for complex ticket handling, advanced troubleshooting, and documentation in coordination with the Tier 3 Managed Services vendor.
  • Participate in Major Incident Management (MIM) for Priority 1 and Priority 2 incidents, perform upgrade testing, ensure WCAG 2.1 accessibility compliance, and apply ITIL principles to IT service and asset management activities.

Requirements

Minimum Qualifications:
  • 15 years of extensive knowledge and understanding of State of Texas applicable policies.
  • 15 years of extensive knowledge of federal labor laws.
  • 15 years of extensive technical skillsets with App Designer, Integration Broker, SQR/SQL, BI Publisher, and SAP Business Objects.
  • 12 years of extensive knowledge and experience performing system configuration changes.
  • 12 years of extensive knowledge supporting and providing oversight of batch jobs, such as Run My Jobs (RMJ).
  • 12 years of extensive knowledge of security best practices, NIST standards, and multi-tenancy applicability for a statewide ERP instance.
  • 10 years of extensive Texas public sector experience, directly working for or supporting a large network of 30 or more Texas state government agencies.
  • 10 years of extensive experience creating and managing a strategic roadmap combining planning skills, functional insight, and cross-functional communication.
  • 10 years of extensive experience supporting the CAPPS HR/PY tower in PeopleSoft HCM version 9.2.
  • 10 years of extensive familiarity with support tools such as PUM, Fluid, and Elastic Search.
  • 10 years of experience performing functional project management activities in support of CPA's CAPPS program.
  • 10 years of experience planning and coordinating the Fiscal Year Process at a statewide level.
  • 10 years of experience providing Tier 2 Service Desk support for a large network of 30 or more agencies with a Managed Services vendor providing Tier 3.
  • 10 years of experience supporting Priority 1 and Priority 2 incidents in coordination with the Major Incident Management (MIM) process.
  • 10 years of experience participating in Disaster Recovery exercises.
  • 10 years of experience preparing and presenting executive-level presentations.
  • 10 years of experience gathering and presenting applicable data in support of audits and open records requests.
  • 10 years of experience interpreting contractual language and integrating it into daily workflows while holding vendors accountable to contractual requirements.
  • 8 years of CPA experience performing SQL actions needed to keep CAPPS and SPRS systems in sync.
  • 8 years of subject matter expertise configuring and coding to remain compliant with the Family Medical Leave Act (FMLA).
  • 8 years of experience preparing WCAG 2.1-compliant materials for distribution.
  • 3 years of knowledge of Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) principles and practices for IT service management (ITSM) and IT asset management (ITAM).
Preferred Qualifications:
  • 10 years of experience with and knowledge of production support activities for CPA's legacy Statewide Financial Systems.
Additional Requirements:
  • Candidate is required to appear in person at CPA's designated location upon commencement of services to obtain CPA equipment, regardless of primary work location.
  • Criminal background check required
  • Experience gathering business requirements for large projects.
  • Ability to work independently in a diverse team environment with on-site and remote team members.
  • Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Knowledge of project management methodologies.
  • Knowledge of the technical and functional attributes of Oracle PeopleSoft.
  • Strong problem-solving and multitasking skills, with readiness to put in extra effort when necessary.
  • Experience with Agile and other SDLC methodologies.
  • Experience with ITIL methodologies.
  • Experience with or knowledge of information security frameworks, such as NIST.
Work Location and Schedule:
Location: Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts, LBJ State Office Building, 111 E. 17th Street, Austin, Texas 78711.
Schedule: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM CT, excluding State holidays.
Work Arrangement: Telework; remote working location must be within the continental United States at all times. On-site attendance at CPA's location may be required on an infrequent, ad-hoc basis, or, at CPA's sole discretion, on a permanent basis requiring a minimum of 24 hours per week on-site.

was bieten wir?

Bei DACHS IT sollst du nicht einfach nur „eine Stelle“ haben, sondern ein Arbeitsumfeld, das zu deinem Leben, deinen Stärken und deinen Zielen passt. Deshalb bieten wir dir:


Remote-First als gelebtes Modell

Wir arbeiten seit Jahren konsequent remote. Du entscheidest, von wo du am produktivsten bist – Homeoffice, Shared Office oder eine Mischung aus beidem.

Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Eigenverantwortung

Du kannst dir deine Arbeit im Rahmen der Projekte zeitlich flexibel über die Woche einteilen. Uns sind Verlässlichkeit im Team und transparente Kommunikation wichtiger als Präsenz am Schreibtisch.

Spannende Projekte statt Routine-Tickets

Gemeinsam finden wir Projekte, die zu deinem Profil und deiner Entwicklung passen – z. B. Plattformaufbau, Cloud-Migration, Automatisierung, Operations oder technische Schulungen bei Kund:innen.

Weiterbildung, Zertifizierungen & Wissensaustausch

Regelmäßige Schulungen und Zertifizierungen sind fest eingeplant – mit Kostenübernahme und Freistellung. Dazu kommen interner Wissensaustausch, Sparrings auf Augenhöhe und Raum, dich fachlich wie methodisch weiterzuentwickeln.

Moderne Ausstattung & Arbeitsumgebung
Du erhältst moderne Hardware, die passende Software sowie das benötigte Equipment, damit du effizient und komfortabel arbeiten kannst.

Attraktive Rahmenbedingungen
Neben einem fairen Festgehalt bekommst du eine jährliche Beteiligung am Unternehmensgewinn. Je nach Rolle besteht zudem die Option auf einen Firmenwagen.

Transparente Feedbackkultur & Entwicklung

Wir setzen nicht auf jährliche Pflichttermine, sondern auf regelmäßige, ehrliche Gespräche auf Augenhöhe – du gibst uns Feedback, wir dir. So wissen wir alle, woran wir sind, und können unsere gemeinsamen nächsten Entwicklungsschritte gezielt unterstützen.

Gesundheit, Freizeit & Sicherheit

Du erhältst 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr, die nicht verfallen, sowie zusätzliche Absicherung, zum Beispiel durch eine Gruppen-Unfallversicherung. So bist du nicht nur beruflich, sondern auch privat gut aufgestellt.

Teamkultur & gemeinsame Erlebnisse

Trotz Remote-First ist uns persönlicher Austausch wichtig: Wir treffen uns regelmäßig zu gemeinsamen Aktivitäten – mal locker bei einem Get-together, mal zum gemeinsamen Workshop, mal aktiv bei Ausflügen – und sorgen so für echten Zusammenhalt abseits des Bildschirms.

wen suchen wir?

Du bist Entwickler:in mit starkem Security-Fokus und bewegst dich sicher in Themen wie Kryptografie, Key Management, PKI und sicheren Protokollen.

Du möchtest Sicherheitsmechanismen nicht nur konfigurieren, sondern selbst implementieren und automatisieren – von KMIP-Schnittstellen über TLS bis hin zu unternehmensweiter PKI-Infrastruktur.

Du arbeitest gern eng mit DevOps-, Backend- und Architektur-Teams zusammen, um unsere Managed Services und Plattformen sicher zu gestalten und Security-by-Design in unsere Lösungen zu integrieren.

was machst du bei uns?

Als Developer Security übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle beim Design und bei der Implementierung sicherheitsrelevanter Komponenten in unseren Managed Services:

  • Du entwickelst und wartest Key Management Systeme (KMS) mit KMIP-Schnittstellen, inklusive Client- und Serverlogik.
  • Du implementierst KMIP-Operationen wie Create, Register, Get, Locate, Destroy, Encrypt/Decrypt, Sign/Verify und stellst eine saubere Abbildung auf interne Datenmodelle sicher.
  • Du analysierst, parsest und erzeugst KMIP-Nachrichten (TTLV, ggf. JSON) und pflegst die zugehörigen Objektattribute (Key Usage, State, Algrithmus, Schlüssellänge, Aktivierungs-/Deaktivierungsdaten).
  • Du verwaltest unterschiedliche Objekttypen wie Symmetric Keys, Public/Private Keys, Zertifikate, Templates und Secret Data.
  • Du integrierst und konfigurierst KMIP-Clients in Anwendungen wie Datenbanken, Storage-Systemen und Applikationsservern.
  • Du baust und pflegst TLS-gesicherte Verbindungen (inkl. Mutual TLS, Client-Zertifikate) zwischen KMS und KMIP-Clients.
  • Du konzipierst und implementierst unternehmensweite PKI-Infrastrukturen, inklusive Root-/Sub-CA-Hierarchien, Richtlinien (CP/CPS), Schlüssellängen, Algorithmen und Laufzeiten.
  • Du erstellst Zertifikatsvorlagen (Server, Client, E-Mail, VPN, Geräte, Code-Signing) und bindest PKI an Verzeichnisdienste (z. B. Active Directory) an, inkl. Auto-Enrollment und Group Policies.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit den Teams für Managed Services, DevOps und Solution Architecture zusammen, um Security-Aspekte in CI/CD, IAM, E-Mail-Verschlüsselung und Cloud-Plattformen zu verankern.

was bringst du mit?

Technical Skills

Must-have

  • Fundierte Erfahrung in der Programmierung von Key Management Systemen (KMS) oder ähnlichen Security-nahen Systemen.

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit KMIP-Schnittstellen (Client- und/oder Serverimplementierung).

  • Kenntnisse der KMIP-Operationen (Create, Register, Get, Locate, Destroy, Encrypt/Decrypt, Sign/Verify) und der zugehörigen Datenstrukturen.

  • Erfahrung im Parsen und Erzeugen von KMIP-Nachrichten (z. B. TTLV, ggf. JSON) und im Mapping auf interne Datenmodelle.

  • Erfahrung in der Verwaltung und Pflege von Objektattributen (Key-Usage, State, Cryptographic Algorithm, Cryptographic Length, Activation/Deactivation Dates).

  • Kenntnisse im Umgang mit verschiedenen kryptografischen Objekttypen (Symmetric Keys, Public/Private Keys, Zertifikate, Templates, Secret Data).

  • Fundierte Erfahrung mit TLS, Zertifikaten und Mutual TLS (inkl. Aufbau und Pflege von sicheren Verbindungen zwischen KMS und Clients).

  • Erfahrung im Security-Engineering, insbesondere in der Konzeption und Umsetzung von PKI-Infrastrukturen.

Nice-to-have

  • Erfahrung im Design von Root-/Sub-CA-Hierarchien (Offline-Root, Issuing-CAs, Trennung nach Use-Cases).

  • Praxis in der Erarbeitung von Policies (CP/CPS) und in der Definition von Sicherheitsrichtlinien für Unternehmensumgebungen.

  • Erfahrung mit HSMs (Hardware Security Module) zur sicheren Schlüsselspeicherung.

  • Kenntnisse in der Integration von PKI in Cloud- und Kubernetes-Umgebungen (z. B. Service-to-Service TLS, Secrets-Management).

  • Erfahrung mit der Anbindung an Verzeichnisdienste (z. B. Active Directory), Auto-Enrollment und Group Policies.

  • Grundkenntnisse in DevOps-/CI/CD-Umgebungen und Zusammenarbeit mit Kubernetes-/Cloud-Teams.

Soft Skills

Must-have

  • Ausgeprägtes Sicherheitsbewusstsein und hoher Qualitätsanspruch bei der Implementierung sicherheitsrelevanter Komponenten.

  • Analytische, strukturierte und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise, insbesondere im Umgang mit sicherheitskritischen Systemen und kryptografischen Materialien.

  • Fähigkeit, komplexe Security-Konzepte verständlich gegenüber Entwicklungsteams, Architekt:innen und ggf. Kund:innen zu vermitteln.

  • Teamfähigkeit und Bereitschaft zur engen Zusammenarbeit mit Backend-, DevOps- und Architektur-Teams.

Nice-to-have

  • Erfahrung in agilen Projekten (Scrum, Kanban) und in der Rolle als Security-Ansprechperson innerhalb eines Projekts.

  • Bereitschaft, interne Schulungen oder Wissenssessions zu Security-Themen durchzuführen.

Spaß daran, Security-Trends (z. B. neue Kryptostandards, Protokolle, Best Practices) zu verfolgen und in unsere Managed Services einzubringen.

wie sieht der bewerbungsprozess bei uns aus?

Wenn du dich bei uns bewirbst, begleiten wir dich transparent durch mehrere klar strukturierte Schritte. Uns ist wichtig, dass du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst – deshalb erhältst du in jeder Phase zeitnah Rückmeldung und alle nötigen Infos zum weiteren Ablauf. In der Regel durchläufst du dabei folgende Schritte:


Screening

Wir sichten deine Unterlagen sorgfältig und bewerten, ob deine Erfahrungen, Kompetenzen und Ziele zu der ausgeschriebenen Rolle und zu DACHS IT passen – auf dieser Basis entscheiden wir über eine Einladung zum Kennenlernen.

Kennenlerngespräch

In einem 30–45-minütigen Videocall lernst du ein Mitglied unseres Teams kennen. Ihr sprecht über deinen Hintergrund, unsere Kultur, Erwartungen beider Seiten und habt Raum für Fragen.

Technisches Interview

In einem 60-minütigen Termin löst du gemeinsam mit ein bis zwei unserer Consultants anspruchsvolle technische Aufgaben. Dabei geht es uns darum, deine Herangehensweise, dein Fachwissen und deine Zusammenarbeit im Team kennenzulernen.

Persönliches Gespräch

Anschließend triffst du unseren Geschäftsführer Alexander. Ihr besprecht verbleibende Fragen, Rahmenbedingungen und wie eine gemeinsame Zukunft bei DACHS IT konkret aussehen könnte.

Angebot

Stimmt die Vorstellung auf beiden Seiten, erhältst du ein Angebot von uns – transparent, nachvollziehbar und mit allen wichtigen Details.

dein profil

Du willst Banaut werden, hast aber keine passende Stellenausschreibung gefunden? Kein Problem! Wir suchen laufend Werkstudenten und Praktikanten. Du kannst auch deine Abschlussarbeit bei uns schreiben. Wir finden den richtigen Platz für dich!

wir bieten

Wir halten nichts von Floskeln wie “immer frisches Obst” und “flache Hierarchien”. Wir täuschen keine super edgy Firmenkultur zur Rechtfertigung von schlechten Arbeitsbedingungen vor. Wir haben das schlechte Image von Agenturarbeit satt und sind der lebende Beweis, dass es in der Branche auch anders laufen kann.   

 

  • Herausforderung: Wir arbeiten für internationale Konzerne, traditionsreichen Mittelstand oder frisch geschlüpfte Start-ups. An spannenden Projekten mangelt es nicht.   
  • Flexibilität: Bei uns hast du ein Arbeitszeitkonto und genießt einen Überstundenausgleich, du entscheidest dich für Freizeit oder Auszahlung. Außerdem sind wir offen gegenüber aller Art von Teilzeitmodellen (50 %, 80 %, etc.), falls du keine 40 Stunden pro Woche arbeiten möchtest. Und für noch mehr Flexibilität bieten wir dir eine Sabbatical Möglichkeit nach mind. einem Jahr bei uns. 
  • Office oder Remote: Falls es zwischen uns passt, hast du die Möglichkeit, 100 % Remote zu arbeiten. Workation im Süden gegen den Winterblues? Bei uns kein Problem. Achja, unser Büro in Stuttgart Mitte ist auch nicht schlecht.   
  • Fairness: Von einem “Dankeschön” kannst du dir nichts kaufen. Deshalb bekommst du bei uns eine überdurchschnittliche Vergütung, angepasst an deine Erfahrung und Leistung.   
  • Kultur: Mit einem Durchschnittsalter von unter 30 Jahren bestehen wir ausschließlich aus Digital Natives. Digitaler Spirit statt angestaubte Firmenkultur. 
  • Benefits: Wir fördern grüne Mobilität und bezahlen dir dein Deutschlandticket oder bezuschussen das Leasing für ein Fahrrad oder einen E-Roller. Außerdem bezuschussen wir deine betriebliche Altersvorsorge. Frisches Obst und kalte Drinks gibt es natürlich auch. 
  • Respekt: Statt Hire & Fire hast du bei uns einen krisensicheren Job mit unbefristetem Arbeitsvertrag. Wir sind eine der wenigen Agenturen, die während der Pandemie eingestellt statt entlassen hat.   
  • Aber auch sonst ist bei uns einiges geboten: regelmäßige Events im Rahmen unserer Banauten & Friends Reihe und eine jährliche Workation mit dem ganzen Team (zum Beispiel auf einem großen Anwesen in Italien). Darüber hinaus hast du ein persönliches Fortbildungsbudget zur Förderung deiner persönlichen Entwicklung.

raw.excerpt: Job DescriptionOne of WFS Group’s rapidly growing financial services clients is seeking highly consultative CFP® professionals to join their inbound sales team and help high net worth retirees make smarter retirement tax planning decisions.
raw.description:
Job Description

One of WFS Group’s rapidly growing financial services clients is seeking highly consultative CFP® professionals to join their inbound sales team and help high net worth retirees make smarter retirement tax planning decisions.

This is NOT a traditional financial advisor role.

You will NOT be:

  • Prospecting

  • Cold calling

  • Networking for referrals

  • Managing assets

  • Building financial plans

  • Hunting for clients

Instead, you’ll spend your time having sophisticated consultative conversations with affluent retirees and pre-retirees who have already expressed interest in advanced retirement tax planning strategies.

This is a high-ticket inbound consultative sales role designed for CFP® professionals who genuinely enjoy client conversations, relationship-building, education, and helping prospects make informed financial decisions.

The ideal candidate is not a “hard closer.”

They are a trusted advisor, a confident communicator, and someone who can create genuine “aha moments” during the conversation.

If you’ve ever thought:

  • “I’m great with clients but tired of building a book”

  • “I love the conversations more than the planning work”

  • “I’d earn significantly more if someone handed me qualified meetings”
    …this may be exactly the opportunity you’ve been looking for.

A Snapshot of WFS Group:

WFS Group is a fast-paced, high-performance outsourced sales organization specializing in helping companies scale through world-class sales talent and infrastructure.

Think of us as an outsourced sales department for fast-growing businesses.

Our clients partner with us to recruit, train, and develop elite sales professionals who can represent their brands at the highest level. We work with innovative companies across multiple industries that rely on consultative sales environments and premium client experiences.

This opportunity is with one of our premier financial services partners specializing in retirement tax planning and wealth strategy solutions.

Position Overview:

As a Senior Wealth Strategy Consultant, you will conduct 25-30 pre-scheduled Zoom consultations per week with high-net-worth prospects generated directly through the client’s marketing engine.

These are warm, inbound conversations with individuals typically:

  • Ages 59-75

  • Holding $1M-$5M+ in retirement assets

  • Actively seeking retirement tax planning guidance

Using the client’s proven consultative framework, you’ll assess each prospect’s retirement situation, educate them on advanced tax planning strategies, and help them determine whether the process is the right fit.

You are the closer, not the planner.

A dedicated planning team handles implementation after the client enrolls.

This role is ideal for professionals who:

  • Communicate with confidence

  • Build trust naturally

  • Simplify complex financial concepts

  • Thrive in relationship-driven conversations

  • Enjoy educating more than “selling”

  • Want the earning upside of sales without the grind of prospecting

Why Top Performers Love This Opportunity:

  • 100% remote environment

  • 25-30 inbound consultations per week provided

  • $200K-$250K+ realistic earning potential

  • No cold calling or prospecting

  • Sophisticated financial conversations with affluent clients

  • High-ticket consultative sales environment

  • Extensive coaching and ongoing development

  • High-performance culture without toxic sales pressure

  • Opportunity to sell a service that genuinely changes lives

Major Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Conduct inbound Zoom consultations with qualified prospects.

  • Use the client’s diagnostic framework to assess retirement planning concerns and tax exposure risks.

  • Educate prospects on retirement tax mitigation and Roth conversion planning concepts.

  • Create meaningful “epiphany moments” that help prospects understand the long-term impact of tax planning decisions.

  • Build trust and credibility through clear, consultative communication.

  • Guide prospects through the decision-making process without relying on pressure-based sales tactics.

  • Manage follow-up conversations and pipeline activity with discipline and consistency.

  • Maintain accurate CRM documentation and forecasting.

  • Participate in coaching sessions, team reviews, and ongoing training initiatives.

  • Consistently achieve or exceed revenue and close-rate targets.

  • Contribute positively to a high-performance, coachable team culture.

Professionals Who Tend To Thrive Here:

  • CFP® professionals who enjoy client conversations more than building plans

  • Advisors tired of prospecting and business development

  • Consultants who naturally create trust and clarity

  • Professionals with strong executive presence on Zoom

  • Financial professionals who enjoy educating more than “selling”

  • Relationship-driven communicators with strong emotional intelligence

  • Advisors who want to maximize income without managing assets

  • Highly coachable professionals who thrive within proven systems

Requirements:

  • CFP® designation in good standing (non-negotiable)

  • 5+ years in a client-facing financial planning, advisory, or consultative financial services role

  • Experience working with high-net-worth individuals

  • Strong consultative communication skills

  • Clean U4 regulatory history

  • Confidence presenting premium planning fees

  • Strong executive presence and professionalism on Zoom

  • High emotional intelligence and active listening ability

  • Strong follow-up discipline and pipeline management skills

  • Coachable mindset with willingness to follow a proven process

  • CRM experience preferred

You SHOULD Apply If:

  • You naturally build trust quickly with people

  • You’re confident without being overly aggressive

  • You enjoy educating and guiding people through financial decisions

  • You have strong executive presence and communication skills

  • You’re tired of building a book from scratch

  • You want inbound opportunities instead of endless prospecting

  • You’re intellectually curious and financially sophisticated

  • You thrive in high-performance environments

  • You want uncapped earning potential tied to performance

You SHOULD NOT Apply If:

  • You prefer technical planning work over client interaction

  • You dislike consultative conversations

  • You want full autonomy instead of a proven process

  • You struggle with follow-up discipline and accountability

  • You dislike performance metrics or coaching

  • You are uncomfortable discussing premium fees confidently

  • You rely heavily on pressure-based sales tactics

  • You are looking for a low-effort advisor role

If you’re a high-performing CFP® professional who loves consultative client conversations but is tired of the traditional advisor grind, this is an opportunity to maximize both your impact and earning potential in a highly differentiated role.

Pay: $100,000.00 - $360,000.00 per year

This position is an Independent Contractor Role - 1099

Flexible Schedule

Work Location: Remote

Compensation Range: $90K - $300K

raw.description:
deine aufgaben

Bei WorkSimple entsteht eine neue Azure AI & Copilot Unit, die sich auf die praktische Umsetzung moderner KI-Lösungen im Microsoft-Ökosystem konzentriert. Unser Ziel ist es, Künstliche Intelligenz gezielt zur Verbesserung realer Prozesse einzusetzen. Dabei setzen wir auf einen pragmatischen, nutzerzentrierten Ansatz: Wir beobachten Abläufe direkt im Arbeitsumfeld der Anwender, identifizieren Optimierungspotenziale und entwickeln daraus konkrete Lösungen.

Als Azure AI / Copilot Engineer & Consultant arbeitest du an der Schnittstelle von Cloud Engineering, KI-Integration und Prozessverständnis. Du entwickelst, integrierst und betreibst Azure AI- und Copilot-Lösungen, die messbaren Nutzen für unsere Kunden schaffen, und gestaltest gleichzeitig den Aufbau dieser neuen Abteilung aktiv mit.

Im Detail heißt das:

  • Entwicklung und Implementierung von Azure AI- und Copilot-Lösungen auf Basis von Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Services, AI Search und Copilot Studio• Technische Integration von Copilot Studio in Microsoft 365, Power Platform oder kundenspezifische Anwendungen
  • Aufbau von RAG-Szenarien, Knowledge Bases und KI-Workflows zur Nutzung von Unternehmensdaten in Chatbots oder digitalen Assistenten
  • Entwicklung von Azure Functions, Logic Apps, APIs und Automatisierungen zur Anbindung externer Systeme
  • Entwicklung von MVPs und Quick-Win-Lösungen, die schnell echten Mehrwert erzeugen

dein profil

Du bist ein technikaffiner Problemlöser mit einem Verständnis für Unternehmensprozesse und Begeisterung für Künstliche Intelligenz. Du möchtest nicht nur beraten, sondern funktionierende Lösungen entwickeln und aktiv gestalten, wie WorkSimple KI im Mittelstand einsetzt.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Entwicklung mit Microsoft Azure / M365
  • Kenntnisse in Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Services oder Copilot Studio
  • Programmierkenntnisse in Python, C# oder TypeScript
  • Verständnis für KI-Architekturen, Datenflüsse, RAG-Konzepte und generative KI
  • Interesse an LLMs, Prompt Engineering und der Integration von unternehmensspezifischem Wissen in KI-Systeme
  • Kommunikationsstärke und die Fähigkeit, technische Inhalte klar und praxisnah zu vermitteln
  • Zertifizierungen wie AI-102, AZ-204, AZ-305 oder PL-400 sind von Vorteil
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1)
Warum WorkSimple und warum ich, Robin, dich suche:

Du arbeitest in einer neuen Abteilung, die du aktiv mitgestalten kannst. Wir möchten Künstliche Intelligenz so einsetzen, dass sie Menschen in ihrem Arbeitsalltag spürbar unterstützt und Aufgaben einfacher macht. Dabei verbinden wir das technische Know-how unseres Cloud-Teams mit einer offenen, bodenständigen Arbeitsweise.

Bei uns kannst du dein Wissen in Azure, AI und Automatisierung direkt in Projekten einsetzen und mit uns gemeinsam Lösungen entwickeln, die wirklich funktionieren. Wir arbeiten eng zusammen, tauschen uns regelmäßig aus und helfen uns gegenseitig, besser zu werden.

arbeiten bei der worksimple

Ich bin Robin und seit fünf Jahren Teil von WorkSimple und verantworte den Aufbau unserer neuen Azure AI & Copilot-Abteilung. Wir sind ein kleines, erfahrenes Team, das Freude daran hat, Dinge anzupacken und Neues auszuprobieren. Unsere Kundenbasis ist da, es gibt viele interessante Projekte. Was uns noch fehlt, ist jemand, der die technische Umsetzung mit vorantreibt und gemeinsam mit uns Erfahrungen sammelt.

Wir suchen keine Perfektion, sondern Neugier und den Wunsch, gemeinsam etwas aufzubauen. Wenn du Spaß an Technologie hast und gerne im Team arbeitest, findest du bei uns den richtigen Platz, um dich einzubringen und etwas zu bewegen.

Beispiele aus unseren Kundenwünschen:

  • Entwicklung von Copilot-Agenten für interne Wissensplattformen und Prozessunterstützung
  • Aufbau von KI-basierten Dokumenten- und Ticket-Assistenten mit Azure OpenAI und Form Recognizer
  • Integration von Copilot Studio in Microsoft Teams und die Power Platform
  • Entwicklung von RAG-Workflows für Wissensmanagement und Supportprozesse
  • Predictive Maintenance und Prozessautomatisierung auf Basis von Machine-Learning-Modellen
  • Quick-Win-Prototypen für Aufgaben wie E-Mail-Klassifikation, Berichtszusammenfassung oder automatisierte Kommunikation

You will be responsible for building and running the operational infrastructure behind A1.

This includes setting up new offices and entities, implementing payroll and local operations, managing vendors, supporting recruiting operations, and ensuring the company can execute efficiently as it scales.

You will be responsible for operational execution across markets.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Lead business operations across multiple countries.

  • Manage and develop a team of Business Operations Partners.

  • Oversee office setup, entity incorporation, and market launches.

  • Oversee payroll implementation and local operational requirements.

  • Manage external vendors and service providers.

  • Support recruiting operations, recruiter onboarding, and hiring activities.

The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams.

This is a hands-on environment. Everyone is expected to contribute directly to the company's success.

raw.description:
At Foxelli, we’re building more than e-commerce brands - we’re building a tribe of thoughtful humans: AI enthusiasts, curious builders, and ambitious minds who care about doing meaningful work together. Ten years in, our D2C brands reach millions and generate over $20M annually. Our focus stays simple: create products customers love and a team that actually enjoys building them.

If you love to learn, experiment, think boldly, make decisions, and build things that matter - you’ll feel at home with us.

WHY JOIN FOXELLI?

We are a fast-moving e-commerce company that builds our own proprietary AI infrastructure. We develop internal AI-driven systems to automate complex creative and analytical workflows, which we later scale into B2B SaaS products.
We are not looking for a traditional developer.

We are looking for an AI-Native Builder who can turn an idea into a functional prototype in days using the latest AI-assisted development tools.

THE ROLE

As a Founding AI Engineer, you will work directly with the founder to design, build, and iterate on various AI systems. The projects will vary - from computer vision and image manipulation to automated video generation and agentic data analysis. You will be responsible for the full pipeline: from R&D of the best AI models to deploying scalable web applications.

Who You Are:

  • Modern Developer: You have abandoned "manual-only" coding. You are a power user of tools like GPT Codex, Claude code, and Replit, allowing you to build at a 10x pace.

  • AI Generalist: You are comfortable working across different AI domains - LLMs (Text/Reasoning), Diffusion (Image/Video), and Vision models.

  • Agile & Adaptive: You thrive in an environment where projects evolve. You are a fast learner who can master a new AI framework or API over a weekend.

  • Hacker Mindset: You focus on ROI. You build lean MVPs, test them in our real-world e-commerce operations, and only then polish them for scale.

  • Architecture-Aware: You know how to orchestrate multiple AI models into a single "Agentic" workflow that handles complex tasks autonomously.

Technical Interests:

  • Stack: Next.js / Python (FastAPI).

  • AI Frameworks: ComfyUI / Diffusers, IP-Adapters, ControlNet, and Agentic frameworks (LangChain/CrewAI).

  • Infrastructure: Experience with Serverless GPU providers (Replicate, Fal, RunPod).

  • Integrations: Skilled at connecting diverse APIs to create seamless automated systems.

Why Join Us:

  • Direct Impact: Build tools that are immediately put to use in real-world business scenarios.

  • Extreme Speed: No corporate red tape. If the tech works, we ship it.

  • Evolution: This is a founding role with the opportunity to lead multiple product lines as we transition from internal tools to SaaS.

THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS

  1. Apply - A simple form that helps us know who’s stepping into our world.

  2. Ribbon AI Interview - Ribbon is a short, guided video step that helps us understand your thinking style in a calm, private space

  3. Interview - A conversation with your manager to feel the work chemistry, get to know each other, and explore what we could build together

FIXED SERVICE FEE

€2000- €3000 after taxes (depending on yourskills, competencies, and experience).

PERKS & BENEFITS

  • Full flexibility with your schedule in a fully remote setting, while Apploye ensures transparency and fairness.

  • Complimentary gym memberships and company-sponsored outdoor adventures for your strength and to keep your physical well-being in check.

  • A personal development budget is at your disposal for your personal and professional growth to ensure you keep growing continuously.

  • Generous paid time off, including parental leave and vacation days, to recharge and rejuvenate and ensure you’re well-rested.

  • A budget for your home office setup so you’re comfortable working how you like and where you like.

  • Strong company culture and a network of unique individuals that celebrate you.

ELIGIBILITY & LOCATION REQUIREMENTS

❕This role is 100% remote.

  • Our tribe works primarily in the Eastern European Time Zone (EET - UTC+2/UTC+3). We also use Revolut for payments, so we are open to hiring candidates in countries where Revolut payments are supported.

  • For full-time roles, we ask that you’re available for at least 5 hours during typical EET working hours - it keeps collaboration smooth and communication easy.

    (This doesn’t apply to part-time roles.)

raw.title: CRM Coordinator
raw.excerpt: About UsInflection Club is a private co-investment community for accredited investors, operators, and family offices who want direct access to pre-IPO deals in the companies shaping the future.
raw.description:
About Us

Inflection Club is a private co-investment community for accredited investors, operators, and family offices who want direct access to pre-IPO deals in the companies shaping the future. Built under Catalyst Capital Holdings, we provide curated access from early to late-stage opportunities that traditionally only flow to endowments, pension funds, and institutional allocators - names like Anthropic, Polymarket, Kraken, and Lovable.

Our thesis is simple: the biggest returns of the next decade will come from companies built on the cost curves of artificial intelligence, robotics, longevity, and next-generation infrastructure. We help our members invest in those companies 12 to 18 months before they go public, deal-by-deal, with full discretion.

We are not a fund. We are a club. No blind pools, no lock-ups, no marketing dressed up as deal flow. Every member chooses what they back, and we handle everything else - sourcing, diligence, SPV formation, legal, reporting, and the live community that makes the whole thing run.

What You Will Do:

The CRM Coordinator is the operational backbone of our member and prospect pipeline. You will own the integrity and performance of our CRM - ensuring every contact, deal stage, and communication touchpoint is accurate, timed, and purposeful.

This is not a data-entry role. We need someone who understands why the data matters, takes ownership of process breakdowns before anyone else notices them, and continuously improves how we track and engage our community. You will work closely with the Director of Community & Operations to ensure no relationship falls through the cracks.

What You'll Own

1. CRM Administration & Data Integrity

  • Own day-to-day administration of HubSpot: contact records, deal stages, pipeline accuracy, custom properties, and lifecycle stages.
  • Maintain a single source of truth for all member and prospect data - clean, current, and actionable.
  • Proactively identify and resolve duplicate records, data anomalies, and process gaps before they surface as problems.

2. Workflows, Sequences & Automation

  • Build and maintain workflows, sequences, and automations that support member acquisition, engagement, and retention.
  • Coordinate with the Partner/Origination and Managing Partner teams to ensure pipeline data reflects real-time activity.
  • Continuously improve the CRM architecture as the club scales - new pipelines, new stages, new segments.

3. Reporting & Funnel Insights

  • Track and report on key funnel metrics: applications, conversions, member tenure, engagement signals, and re-engagement triggers.
  • Surface insights to leadership in a clear, concise format - no noise, just signal.
  • Build and maintain dashboards that give the team visibility into pipeline health at a glance.

4. List Segmentation & Campaign Coordination

  • Own audience segmentation and list management for outreach campaigns coordinated with the Director of Community & Operations.
  • Ensure the right message reaches the right segment at the right time - and that results are tracked cleanly.

5. Member Onboarding Flows

  • Support the operational layer of new member onboarding - ensuring the right communications go out on schedule and that member records are updated as they move through each stage.
  • Liaise with the Director of Community & Operations to keep onboarding workflows current and optimised.

Requirements

Who You Are:

      • 2+ years of hands-on CRM or revenue operations experience, with HubSpot as a hard requirement.
      • You have a strong grasp of sales pipeline management, lifecycle stages, and funnel reporting - not just where to find them in a dashboard, but what they mean.
      • You can build workflows and sequences without hand-holding. You know when automation helps and when it creates more problems than it solves.
      • You have exceptional attention to detail. You notice when something is off, and you fix it before being asked.
      • You are async-first and comfortable operating in a fast-moving, distributed team across time zones.
      • You communicate clearly and concisely - in writing, always.

Bonus Points

      • Experience in financial services, investment communities, high-ticket sales, or private membership organisations.
      • Familiarity with Web3, DeFi, or crypto-adjacent audiences.
      • Exposure to SPV workflows, investor relations, or regulated communications.
      • Experience with ClickUp, Slack automation, or n8n.

How We Work

    • Inflection Club's leadership operates on a Yin-Yang model borrowed from how our founders built Decentralized Masters. Every major initiative gets multiple sets of eyes before it ships. You will work closely with the Director of Community & Operations and surface issues early. You will own your domain. And you will be expected to set the quality bar - not wait for it to be set for you.
    • We move quickly. We do not tolerate sloppiness. We expect the CRM to be a tool that makes the team faster and sharper, not a system people work around.

Benefits

  • Fully remote - work from anywhere.
  • Flexible, async-first culture with deep focus time built in.
  • Competitive independent contractor rate commensurate with experience.
  • Direct exposure to institutional-grade deal flow and a high-calibre investor community.
  • Ground-floor opportunity in a private co-investment club being built to scale.

Are You Ready?

This is a rare opportunity to own the operational intelligence layer of a private investment community that is growing fast and playing for the long game. If you are the kind of person who finds broken processes and fixes them before being asked - and who wants to be part of something being built to last - we want to hear from you.

Apply with your CV in English, along with a brief note on the CRM system you know best and one process improvement you have owned end-to-end. We move quickly and will be in touch with shortlisted candidates within two weeks.

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

The Senior Systems Analyst will support the Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts on the Centralized Accounting and Payroll/Personnel System (CAPPS) Program. This role is part of CPA's Fiscal Management Statewide Fiscal Systems team and provides advanced functional and consultative support across the CAPPS HR/Payroll tower, including HR/Payroll, Financials, STARR, and ancillary systems. The Senior Systems Analyst serves as a primary point of contact for CAPPS agencies, supporting functional design, system configuration, and compliance activities such as FMLA administration and WCAG 2.1 accessibility standards. The role also oversees batch job monitoring, Fiscal Year-End coordination, and the CAPPS Annual Disaster Recovery exercise. The Senior Systems Analyst works under minimal supervision, applying independent judgment to support a statewide network of more than 100 Texas state agencies and approximately 80,000 employees on the CAPPS Central platform.
Responsibilities:
  • Provide advanced consultative and functional support for the CAPPS HR/Payroll tower, including Workforce Administration, Payroll Interface, Commitment Accounting, Time and Labor, TAM/CG, and HR security setup, including row-level security.
  • Ensure CAPPS compliance with the Family Medical Leave Act (FMLA) by defining leave plans, customizing leave types, and supporting compliance reporting and auditing.
  • Serve as the functional point of contact for CAPPS agencies, creating and reviewing Functional Design Documents (FDDs) and performing functional configuration changes.
  • Configure system tables, business units, Set IDs, and table structures, and build workflow configurations using the Approval Workflow Engine (AWE).
  • Create queries and reports using PS/Query, SAP Business Objects, SQR, and BI Publisher, applying technical knowledge of Application Designer, Integration Broker, and SQL.
  • Monitor batch job schedules and execution, detect and respond to failures, validate output, manage dependencies, and document performance tuning activities.
  • Coordinate Fiscal Year-End activities, including reconciliations, system configurations, mass salary loads, and Benefit Enrollment Web Services integration with ERS.
  • Coordinate the CAPPS Annual Disaster Recovery exercise with the Managed Services vendor, including test scope definition, backup validation, and documentation of results.
  • Provide Level 2 Service Desk support for complex ticket handling, advanced troubleshooting, and documentation in coordination with the Tier 3 Managed Services vendor.
  • Participate in Major Incident Management (MIM) for Priority 1 and Priority 2 incidents, perform upgrade testing, ensure WCAG 2.1 accessibility compliance, and apply ITIL principles to IT service and asset management activities.

Requirements

Minimum Qualifications:
  • 15 years of extensive knowledge and understanding of State of Texas applicable policies.
  • 15 years of extensive knowledge of federal labor laws.
  • 15 years of extensive technical skillsets with App Designer, Integration Broker, SQR/SQL, BI Publisher, and SAP Business Objects.
  • 12 years of extensive knowledge and experience performing system configuration changes.
  • 12 years of extensive knowledge supporting and providing oversight of batch jobs, such as Run My Jobs (RMJ).
  • 12 years of extensive knowledge of security best practices, NIST standards, and multi-tenancy applicability for a statewide ERP instance.
  • 10 years of extensive Texas public sector experience, directly working for or supporting a large network of 30 or more Texas state government agencies.
  • 10 years of extensive experience creating and managing a strategic roadmap combining planning skills, functional insight, and cross-functional communication.
  • 10 years of extensive experience supporting the CAPPS HR/PY tower in PeopleSoft HCM version 9.2.
  • 10 years of extensive familiarity with support tools such as PUM, Fluid, and Elastic Search.
  • 10 years of experience performing functional project management activities in support of CPA's CAPPS program.
  • 10 years of experience planning and coordinating the Fiscal Year Process at a statewide level.
  • 10 years of experience providing Tier 2 Service Desk support for a large network of 30 or more agencies with a Managed Services vendor providing Tier 3.
  • 10 years of experience supporting Priority 1 and Priority 2 incidents in coordination with the Major Incident Management (MIM) process.
  • 10 years of experience participating in Disaster Recovery exercises.
  • 10 years of experience preparing and presenting executive-level presentations.
  • 10 years of experience gathering and presenting applicable data in support of audits and open records requests.
  • 10 years of experience interpreting contractual language and integrating it into daily workflows while holding vendors accountable to contractual requirements.
  • 8 years of CPA experience performing SQL actions needed to keep CAPPS and SPRS systems in sync.
  • 8 years of subject matter expertise configuring and coding to remain compliant with the Family Medical Leave Act (FMLA).
  • 8 years of experience preparing WCAG 2.1-compliant materials for distribution.
  • 3 years of knowledge of Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) principles and practices for IT service management (ITSM) and IT asset management (ITAM).
Preferred Qualifications:
  • 10 years of experience with and knowledge of production support activities for CPA's legacy Statewide Financial Systems.
Additional Requirements:
  • Candidate is required to appear in person at CPA's designated location upon commencement of services to obtain CPA equipment, regardless of primary work location.
  • Criminal background check required
  • Experience gathering business requirements for large projects.
  • Ability to work independently in a diverse team environment with on-site and remote team members.
  • Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Knowledge of project management methodologies.
  • Knowledge of the technical and functional attributes of Oracle PeopleSoft.
  • Strong problem-solving and multitasking skills, with readiness to put in extra effort when necessary.
  • Experience with Agile and other SDLC methodologies.
  • Experience with ITIL methodologies.
  • Experience with or knowledge of information security frameworks, such as NIST.
Work Location and Schedule:
Location: Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts, LBJ State Office Building, 111 E. 17th Street, Austin, Texas 78711.
Schedule: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM CT, excluding State holidays.
Work Arrangement: Telework; remote working location must be within the continental United States at all times. On-site attendance at CPA's location may be required on an infrequent, ad-hoc basis, or, at CPA's sole discretion, on a permanent basis requiring a minimum of 24 hours per week on-site.
